verses.gurmukhi: ਖਾਂਡ ਖਾਂਡ ਕਹੈ ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਦ ਮੀਠੋ ਆਵੈ ਅਗਨਿ ਅਗਨਿ ਕਹੈ ਸੀਤ ਨ ਬਿਨਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: khaa(n)dd khaa(n)dd kahai jihabaa na savaiaadh meeTho aavai agan agan kahai seet na binaas hai ||

en.bdb: No action but repeated utterances are futile. Repeatedly saying sugar, the tongue is unable to experience sweet taste, nor shivering with cold can stop by saying fire! fire!

verses.gurmukhi: ਬੈਦ ਬੈਦ ਕਹੈ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟਤ ਨ ਕਾਹੰੂ ਕੋ ਦ੍ਰਬ ਦ੍ਰਬ ਕਹੈ ਕੋਊ ਦ੍ਰਬਹਿ ਨ ਬਿਲਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: baidh baidh kahai rog miTat na kaaha(n)oo ko dhrab dhrab kahai kouoo dhrabeh na bilaas hai ||

en.bdb: No ailment can be cured by repeated utterance of doctor! doctor! nor can anyone enjoy the luxuries that money buys just by saying money! money!

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੰਦਨ ਚੰਦਨ ਕਹਤ ਪ੍ਰਗਟੈ ਨ ਸੁਬਾਸ ਬਾਸੁ ਚੰਦ ਚੰਦ ਕਹੈ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਨ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: cha(n)dhan cha(n)dhan kahat pragaTai na subaas baas cha(n)dh cha(n)dh kahai ujiaaro na pragaas hai ||

en.bdb: Just as saying sandalwood! sandalwood, the fragrance of sandalwood cannot spread, nor can the radiance of the moon-light be experienced by repeatedly saying moon! moon! unless the moon rises.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਗਯਾਨ ਗੋਸਟਿ ਕਰਤ ਨ ਰਹਤ ਪਾਵੈ ਕਰਨੀ ਪ੍ਰਧਾਨ ਭਾਨ ਉਦਤਿ ਅਕਾਸ ਹੈ ॥੪੩੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise gayaan gosaT karat na rahat paavai karanee pradhaan bhaan udhat akaas hai ||437||

en.bdb: Similarly, just listening to holy sermons and discourses, one cannot acquire the divine life-style and code of conduct. The fundamental need is to practice them in actual life. Then the light radiance of the effulgent Lord is experienced. (437)
